bridgeRouteRisk.summary: TRYB's native issuer deployments remain separate from Polygon's reviewed PoS lock/mint representation. Reciprocal Ethereum/Polygon mappings resolve the root token, ERC20Predicate escrow and sole ChildChainManager depositor. The Polygon upgrade path terminates at a 5-of-9 Safe through a legacy 1-of-1 wallet; Ethereum bridge upgrades terminate at a separate 5-of-9 Safe through a zero-delay timelock. No single-key or mandatory-delay protection is inferred from those intermediate contracts.
